calls.title: Correct seven triage titles?
calls.text: Four whole-college Credit by Exam exhibits carry one course's title (Plant Propagation among them), and CompTIA A+, Network+ and Server+ sit under Security+, from the 2026-11-01 triage.

calls.title: Are these five exhibit issuers the places that train, rather than the bodies that issue?
calls.text: Proctored Testing Center, California Specialized Training Institute, Graduate Level Institution of Higher Education, Johnson Controls Training Institute and Spaulding Marine Center read as training sites (probability 0.66 to 0.90, no measured threshold).

answer.words: Correct the clear two, on Open Asks Sheet 180 card 6, and go with the recommendation on the other three.

next_step.title: The classifier proposes a title in use before a new one
next_step.text: The proposal step takes the statewide or most used title of the same issuer before a new one, and names an industry certification by its official name rather than a course title, on Sam's two rulings of 2026-11-12. It is in build; its report counts the Proposed cards it changes, and it merges on a green test after review.

changes.text: A ghost delete now holds when a case-only successor is absent, and its plan refuses a before-row under the disclosure floor of 10. Pull request 3166 merged.

The Review card names the statewide or most used title of its own issuer, and the side panel changes the related titles that need it to a chosen title, through the rename batch's own rows. Pull request 3160 merged.
Sierra's 230 ghost rows were deleted on Sam's word, delete; the live table holds 2,719 rows, the reference's own count. The receipt in kb/receipts holds the undo.
Course details opens a Review card's aligned course in the side panel. Pull request 3157 merged.
Stored credential titles resolve when they are read, through the applied renames, and retired names became search aliases. The pull request that re-pointed saved values at apply time was closed.
ASE plan phase 3 applied: five title assignments, read back five.

The second standards plan applied: seven more ASE titles renamed to their standards form, L1, A2, A6, L3, A9, A3 and A4. Sam's seven approval rows the apply carried out were removed, each kept in the receipt, and twelve subject rows followed the titles. The receipt's undo runs before the first plan's.

The first standards plan applied: three titles renamed to Brakes (ASE A5 standards), Heating and Air Conditioning (ASE A7 standards) and Engine Performance (ASE A8 standards), and one merged into the A8 title. Sam's seven approval rows the apply carried out were removed, each kept in the receipt, and six subject rows followed the titles. The receipt's undo puts every value back.

Two more titles carry the ASE Certificate Bundles family as members any one of whose tests qualifies: ASE C1 or G1 and ASE Certification (any A1 to A8). 25 family tags are live under credential-family-s638@bot; the family apply's rollback undoes them.

Sheet 181's ruled renames applied: 22 bundle titles now read ASE Certificate Bundles: A4 + A5 and the like, and two pairs merged into one title each. Sam's 47 fold rows stayed on the old titles, 25 rows moved to the new ones, and one bot family tag on a merged twin was removed. The receipt's undo puts every value back.

The 13 rows people had saved on the eight titles the ASE plans emptied are back, under their own reviewers and stamps: 12 of Sam's and one map@rccd.edu issuer row. The four July reviewed ticks stay retired.
24 ASE bundle titles carry the ASE Certificate Bundles family as a field, beside Sam's saved folds, which stay as they are.
